verdict.rationale: Analytics data can be exported from the dashboard as CSV or XLSX. The Search API and CLI can manage indices, records, settings, rules and synonyms, which implies records and configuration could be retrieved programmatically. Since Algolia only searches a copy of your data, the source of truth stays with you, though no explicit bulk-export workflow is documented. Missing for 10: documented full export of index records, settings, rules and synonyms in open formats; an explicit migration-out or data-portability guide; independent hands-on corroboration of a complete export.
